primitive: REG_GLM penalty l2 / l1 / elasticnet: glmnet's objective, unstandardised, intercept unpenalised
r_function: glmnet(x, y, family, weights, alpha = l1_ratio, lambda = alpha, standardize = FALSE, control = list(thresh = 1e-20, maxit = 1e7))
note: Pulse alpha = glmnet lambda; Pulse l1_ratio = glmnet alpha (l2 0, l1 1). rows are [predictors..., y, w]; N* = sum(w). std_errors: l2 the penalised-Fisher sandwich H^-1 A H^-1 at glmnet's solution; l1 / elasticnet null on every coefficient (no valid inference after data-driven selection). deviance: the unpenalised deviance at the penalised estimate. Every case is self-checked against the KKT conditions of the stated objective at relative 1e-10.
